title: The Purpose of Mathematics according to Plato and Augustine
summary: In 1973, Russian mathematician I.R. Shafarevitch delivered a lecture to the Göttingen Academy of Sciences on the purpose of mathematics. The conclusion he reached in his address is that the ultimate purpose of mathematics must be religious. In this talk, we will explore a possible way in which this claim can be justified by understanding the purpose that mathematics served within a person's intellectual formation according to Plato.
